title: ntop nDPI through 6.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and unsigned length underflow in ndpi_serializer_get_buffer()…
description: ntop nDPI versions through 6.0 have a heap out-of-bounds read and unsigned length underflow vulnerability in the ndpi_serializer_get_buffer() function. This occurs when stripping leading NUL and space bytes from buffers that contain only spaces or NULs, or when the buffer length is set to zero. The flaw can cause reads beyond the allocated heap buffer or a length wraparound, potentially crashing the application embedding nDPI.
